title: [Login Records API - GET /api/traveler/login-records] Negative page=-1 Query Parameter Clamps to page=1 With HTTP 200 OK (Pagination Contract Verification)
environment: Staging (STAG) · Strapi Backend API & Desktop 1440×900 · Chrome · en-US · FE=turbopack-2h-u0he6dowwt, BE=<CHECK_DEPLOYED_SHA> (https://web.stag.goodnstay.com/en-US/user-profile/profile-details)
test_account: Signed-In QA Traveler Session on Staging (Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED_QA_TOKEN>)
steps_to_reproduce: Confirm baseline GET https://services.stag.goodnstay.com/api/traveler/login-records?page=1&pageSize=6 returns HTTP 200 OK.
Single-Variable Query Mutation: Change ONLY query parameter page from 1 to -1 (keeping pageSize=6).
Send GET https://services.stag.goodnstay.com/api/traveler/login-records?page=-1&pageSize=6 and inspect HTTP status and data.page.
actual_result: - GET /api/traveler/login-records?page=-1&pageSize=6 returns HTTP 200 OK ("Login records loaded.") and silently clamps data.page to 1, whereas sibling Staging endpoint GET /api/v1/notifications?limit=-5 returns HTTP 400 VALIDATION_FAILED ('limit must not be less than 1').
expected_result: - <CHECK_OPENAPI> / <CHECK_ERROR_REGISTRY>: Because STAGING OpenAPI for Strapi /api/traveler/login-records is unpublished (404), confirm with Strapi Backend Owner whether negative pagination parameters (page < 1) must fail closed with HTTP 400 Bad Request (matching /api/v1/notifications) or intentionally clamp to page=1.
